steps: +ed: look — looked, open — opened, play — played, listen — listened, laugh — laughed, start — started, visit — visited, stay — stayed. +d: like — liked, taste — tasted, bake — baked, live — lived, love — loved, hope — hoped, close — closed.

4-s83.answer: +ed — looked, opened, played, listened, laughed, started, visited, stayed; +d — liked, tasted, baked, lived, loved, hoped, closed; -ied — studied, carried, worried, cried, tried; удвоение — stopped, clapped, dropped.
